title: Fort Langley, Bridal Veil Falls and Winery Private tour
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Our travelers will have the opportunity to walk through the ancient city Fort Langley, the center of gold mining in BC, visit establishments and buy souvenirs, go to the unforgettable Bridal Veil Falls, walk through the forest near it and take wonderful photographs, and finally, on our trip, visit a wonderful city Abbotsford with a huge number of wineries, where you can enjoy not only delicious wine, but also a beautiful view.
